# Flex Digital

> Flex Digital is a Ghana-based digital transformation advisory and education firm. It helps Boards, executive teams and institutions across Africa shape, govern and deliver digital transformation. Advice is vendor-neutral. Consultants have worked across eight markets in Africa and Europe.

## Services
- [Strategy & Governance](https://flexdigital.africa/strategy-governance.html): We help organisations define transformation priorities, strengthen technology governance and make strategic decisions with confidence. Offerings: Digital Transformation Strategy & Roadmap; Technology, Security & AI Governance; Enterprise Architecture; Benefits Realisation.
- [People & Leadership](https://flexdigital.africa/people-leadership.html): We equip Boards, executives and employees with the knowledge, skills and leadership capabilities needed to navigate transformation. Offerings: Board & Executive Education; Employee & Digital Skills Audit; Change Leadership; Workforce Transition Management.
- [Delivery & Solutions](https://flexdigital.africa/delivery-solutions.html): We provide the expertise, governance and technical leadership required to deliver complex transformation programmes and digital solutions. Offerings: Technology Selection & Due Diligence; Programme Assurance & PMO; Bespoke Digital Technology Solutions; CTO-as-a-Service.

## Company
- [About Flex Digital](https://flexdigital.africa/about.html): Who we are, the Flex Digital advantage and the three co-founders: Ebo Richardson (Co-founder & Principal Consultant); Akua Richardson (Co-founder & Managing Consultant); Collins Lartey (Co-founder & Delivery Lead).
- [Services overview](https://flexdigital.africa/services.html): The three service lines, methodology (Assess, Engage, Design, Mobilise) and common questions.

## Key facts
- Based in: Ghana. Serves organisations across Africa.
- Typical clients: Boards and committees, CEOs, CIOs and CTOs, risk and compliance leaders, HR and People leaders, transformation and programme teams.
- Frameworks referenced where relevant: COBIT, NIST CSF, ISO 27001.
- Engagement model: tailored scope, duration and outputs; four-stage methodology (Assess, Engage, Design, Mobilise).
- Tagline: Transform tomorrow, today.
